; Adds an "Alarm" entry to the reMarkable sidebar, directly under Integrations,
; that opens the openremarkable Alarm (an AppLoad app) full screen.
;
; Written against firmware 3.25.1.1, where the Integrations foldout sits inside
; DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler in Sidebar.qml.
; Applied by qt-resource-rebuilder (XOVI); install into
; /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/ next to appload.qmd.
; Requires AppLoad with the alarm installed as id "openremarkable-alarm", and alarm-island.qmd for the notification.
;
; Unlike the Integrations foldout, this entry doesn't depend on Wi-Fi.
; It also hides AppLoad's own "AppLoad" sidebar entry, which isn't needed
; (at runtime, so it works whichever patch is applied first).

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler
        INSERT {
            SidebarFilterItem {
                id: openAlarm
                objectName: "openAlarm"
                title: "Alarm"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/system_clock"
                active: false
                Layout.preferredHeight: Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                navigationHandler: sidebar
                onClicked: activate()

                function activate() {
                    sidebar.toggle();
                    AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("openremarkable-alarm", [], {}, false);
                }

                Component.onCompleted: {
                    for (var i = 0; i < parent.children.length; i++) {
                        if (parent.children[i].objectName === "openAppLoad") parent.children[i].visible = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
